relations: Flame beneath the spoon bowl heats the solid wax pieces, causing them to soften and melt into a liquid pool.
As wax melts, the pink, purple, and white flower shapes lose definition and blend into a glossy colored liquid.
The spoon stays resting on the white stand, tilted so molten wax gathers toward the bowl's low side.
Continued heating makes the melted wax spread and shimmer, with colors diffusing across the bowl surface.
